card.name: Words leading into rare disease descriptions
card.fires_on: Words just before a disease or condition noun where 'rare' or 'uncommon' could come next, such as 'a', 'the', 'most', 'other' or 'rare' itself. Seen in text on genetic or inherited diseases.

modes.label: The word rare itself
modes.description: Fires on 'rare' when it describes a genetic or childhood disease.
modes.example: TORONTO - Canadian researchers have used the power of genomics to identify the cause of a<< rare>> Parkinson's-like disease in children of one

modes.label: Modifier before disease class
modes.description: Fires on small words or adjectives like 'the', 'common', 'severe' placed before a disease or event term.
modes.example: (AMD), the most<< common>> cause of blindness in older Americans?

modes.label: Quote or link before disease name
modes.description: Fires on a quote mark or linking word right before a disease name.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write 'rare' or 'uncommon' as the next word, in the sense of how often a condition occurs.
card.plain: It lights up where a sentence is about to call a disease rare or uncommon.
